content: Root cause: The bug was caused by the incorrect ordering of netlink notifications during the creation of a VXLAN device. Specifically, a default FDB (Forwarding Database) entry was being added and notified to user-space before the net device was registered, leading to a race condition where user-space was notified of the FDB entry before it was aware of the new net device. This resulted in user-space potentially receiving notifications for a device that it did not yet recognize, causing inconsistencies and potential errors in handling the FDB entry. The patch resolves this by decoupling the FDB notification from its creation and ensuring that the notification occurs only after the net device has been registered.
